documentText:
Page 1: Enterprise Checkout Platform PRD. Supports single-click tokenized payments and multi-currency tax calculation.

Page 2: Audit & Compliance Ledger. Every payment state transition must emit an immutable audit record with trace_id and actor_id.

epics.title: Tokenized Payment Checkout
epics.description: Enable low-latency tokenized card and wallet payments across currencies.
epics.rationale: Core revenue path explicitly detailed in Page 1.

epics.title: Immutable Compliance Ledger
epics.description: Record every payment mutation with actor and trace correlation.

pass1.extraction_notes: Multi-page requirements document with clear payment and compliance boundaries.

stories.title: Process single-click tokenized card charge
stories.description: As a returning buyer, I want to pay using my stored payment token, so that checkout completes in under 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid stored payment token, When checkout is submitted, Then the charge is authorized within 2000ms.
Given an expired token, When checkout is submitted, Then an actionable re-auth error is returned.

stories.title: Emit immutable ledger entry on payment transition
stories.description: As a compliance auditor, I want every payment state change logged immutably, so that audits trace actor and request context.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment state transition, When persistence commits, Then an append-only ledger entry is written with trace_id.
